theorems.name: overcurrent_reverses_closing
theorems.doc: (S) An overcurrent while closing reverses the door (it opens).
theorems.statement:
theorem overcurrent_reverses_closing (t now : Std.U64) (drv : Bool) (ol : Option Bool) :
    door_step { state := .Closing, last := .Closing, timeout := t }
      { open_limit := ol, close_limit := none, cmd := none, overcurrent := true } now drv
      = ok ({ state := .Opening, last := .Closing, timeout := t }, { NOTHING with take_overcurrent := true })
theorems.proof:
theorem overcurrent_reverses_closing (t now : Std.U64) (drv : Bool) (ol : Option Bool) :
    door_step { state := .Closing, last := .Closing, timeout := t }
      { open_limit := ol, close_limit := none, cmd := none, overcurrent := true } now drv
      = ok ({ state := .Opening, last := .Closing, timeout := t }, { NOTHING with take_overcurrent := true }) := by
  simp [door_step, same]

theorems.name: overcurrent_stops_opening
theorems.doc: (S) An overcurrent while opening stops the door.
theorems.statement:
theorem overcurrent_stops_opening (t now : Std.U64) (drv : Bool) (cl : Option Bool) :
    door_step { state := .Opening, last := .Opening, timeout := t }
      { open_limit := none, close_limit := cl, cmd := none, overcurrent := true } now drv
      = ok ({ state := .Idle, last := .Opening, timeout := t }, { NOTHING with take_overcurrent := true })
theorems.proof:
theorem overcurrent_stops_opening (t now : Std.U64) (drv : Bool) (cl : Option Bool) :
    door_step { state := .Opening, last := .Opening, timeout := t }
      { open_limit := none, close_limit := cl, cmd := none, overcurrent := true } now drv
      = ok ({ state := .Idle, last := .Opening, timeout := t }, { NOTHING with take_overcurrent := true }) := by
  simp [door_step, same]

theorems.name: timeout_stops
theorems.doc: (S) A movement still going at its deadline (10 s after it started) stops: the door goes Idle (and, entering Idle, stops the pulley).
theorems.statement:
theorem timeout_stops (s : DoorState) (hs : s = .Opening ∨ s = .Closing) (t now : Std.U64) (drv : Bool)
    (ol cl : Option Bool) (hol : s = .Opening → ol = none) (hcl : s = .Closing → cl = none)
    (h : t.val ≤ now.val) :
    door_step { state := s, last := s, timeout := t }
      { open_limit := ol, close_limit := cl, cmd := none, overcurrent := false } now drv
      = ok ({ state := .Idle, last := s, timeout := t }, NOTHING)
theorems.proof:
theorem timeout_stops (s : DoorState) (hs : s = .Opening ∨ s = .Closing) (t now : Std.U64) (drv : Bool)
    (ol cl : Option Bool) (hol : s = .Opening → ol = none) (hcl : s = .Closing → cl = none)
    (h : t.val ≤ now.val) :
    door_step { state := s, last := s, timeout := t }
      { open_limit := ol, close_limit := cl, cmd := none, overcurrent := false } now drv
      = ok ({ state := .Idle, last := s, timeout := t }, NOTHING) := by
  have ht : now ≥ t := by scalar_tac
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl
  · simp at hol; subst hol; simp [door_step, same, h]
  · simp at hcl; subst hcl; simp [door_step, same, h]

theorems.name: stale_overcurrent_ignored
theorems.doc: (S) F1: an overcurrent flag already pending when a close starts is taken and discarded: the close goes on (upstream reverses at once).
theorems.statement:
theorem stale_overcurrent_ignored (last : DoorState) (hl : last ≠ .Closing) (t now : Std.U64) (drv : Bool)
    (ol : Option Bool) (hn : now.val < 2 ^ 63) :
    ∃ d o, door_step { state := .Closing, last := last, timeout := t }
        { open_limit := ol, close_limit := none, cmd := none, overcurrent := true } now drv = ok (d, o) ∧
      d.state = .Closing ∧ o.take_overcurrent = true ∧ o.pulley = some .RampUpCW
theorems.proof:
theorem stale_overcurrent_ignored (last : DoorState) (hl : last ≠ .Closing) (t now : Std.U64) (drv : Bool)
    (ol : Option Bool) (hn : now.val < 2 ^ 63) :
    ∃ d o, door_step { state := .Closing, last := last, timeout := t }
        { open_limit := ol, close_limit := none, cmd := none, overcurrent := true } now drv = ok (d, o) ∧
      d.state = .Closing ∧ o.take_overcurrent = true ∧ o.pulley = some .RampUpCW := by
  have hv := sat64_val now DOOR_TIMEOUT_MS
  rw [timeout_val] at hv
  have hlt : ¬ ((core.num.U64.saturating_add now DOOR_TIMEOUT_MS).val ≤ now.val) := by rw [hv]; omega
  cases last <;> simp at hl <;> simp [door_step, same, lift, hlt]

theorems.name: no_motion_without_driver
theorems.doc: (S) F2: without the pulley driver, a stopped door stays stopped: no command moves it and it sends the pulley nothing but a stop.
theorems.statement:
theorem no_motion_without_driver (d : Door) (p : Pending) (now : Std.U64)
    (hs : d.state = .Idle ∨ d.state = .Opened ∨ d.state = .Closed) :
    ∃ d' o, door_step d p now false = ok (d', o) ∧ d'.state = d.state ∧
      (o.pulley = none ∨ o.pulley = some .Stop)
theorems.proof:
theorem no_motion_without_driver (d : Door) (p : Pending) (now : Std.U64)
    (hs : d.state = .Idle ∨ d.state = .Opened ∨ d.state = .Closed) :
    ∃ d' o, door_step d p now false = ok (d', o) ∧ d'.state = d.state ∧
      (o.pulley = none ∨ o.pulley = some .Stop) := by
  rcases d with ⟨st, la, t⟩
  rcases p with ⟨ol, cl, cmd, oc⟩
  simp only at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> cases la <;> rcases cmd with _ | c <;>
    (try cases c) <;> simp [door_step, same, is_open, NOTHING]

theorems.name: stop_kept_while_ramping_down
theorems.doc: (S) F3: a stop while ramping down is kept: the pulley stops instead of ramping up the other way.
theorems.statement:
theorem stop_kept_while_ramping_down (dest : PulleyState) (duty : Std.U8) :
    pulley_step { state := .RampingDownCCW, dest, duty } (some .Stop)
      = ok ({ state := .RampingDownCCW, dest := .Hold, duty }, none) ∧
    pulley_step { state := .RampingDownCW, dest, duty } (some .Stop)
      = ok ({ state := .RampingDownCW, dest := .Hold, duty }, none)
theorems.proof:
theorem stop_kept_while_ramping_down (dest : PulleyState) (duty : Std.U8) :
    pulley_step { state := .RampingDownCCW, dest, duty } (some .Stop)
      = ok ({ state := .RampingDownCCW, dest := .Hold, duty }, none) ∧
    pulley_step { state := .RampingDownCW, dest, duty } (some .Stop)
      = ok ({ state := .RampingDownCW, dest := .Hold, duty }, none) := by
  constructor <;> simp [pulley_step]

theorems.name: stop_in_hold_cancels
theorems.doc: (S) F3: a stop in Hold cancels a pending reversal.
theorems.statement:
theorem stop_in_hold_cancels (dest : PulleyState) (duty : Std.U8) :
    pulley_step { state := .Hold, dest, duty } (some .Stop)
      = ok ({ state := .Hold, dest := .Hold, duty }, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
theorems.proof:
theorem stop_in_hold_cancels (dest : PulleyState) (duty : Std.U8) :
    pulley_step { state := .Hold, dest, duty } (some .Stop)
      = ok ({ state := .Hold, dest := .Hold, duty }, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 }) := by
  simp [pulley_step]

theorems.name: one_channel_at_a_time
theorems.doc: (S) One channel at a time (the H-bridge's two inputs never both on).
theorems.statement:
theorem one_channel_at_a_time (p : Pulley) (c : Option PulleyCommand) (h : p.duty.val ≤ 100) :
    pulley_step p c ⦃ r => ∀ d, r.2 = some d → d.a.val = 0 ∨ d.b.val = 0 ⦄
theorems.proof:
theorem one_channel_at_a_time (p : Pulley) (c : Option PulleyCommand) (h : p.duty.val ≤ 100) :
    pulley_step p c ⦃ r => ∀ d, r.2 = some d → d.a.val = 0 ∨ d.b.val = 0 ⦄ := by
  have hm := max_val
  rcases p with ⟨st, de, du⟩
  simp only at h
  cases st
  case Hold =>
    cases de <;> rcases c with _ | pc <;> (try cases pc) <;> simp_all [pulley_step]
  all_goals
    rcases c with _ | pc <;> (try cases pc) <;> simp only [pulley_step] <;>
      (try split_ifs) <;> step* <;> (try simp_all) <;> (try scalar_tac) <;> (try omega)

theorems.name: duty_at_most_max
theorems.statement:
theorem duty_at_most_max (p : Pulley) (c : Option PulleyCommand) (h : p.duty.val ≤ 100) :
    pulley_step p c ⦃ r => r.1.duty.val ≤ 100 ∧ ∀ d, r.2 = some d → d.a.val ≤ 100 ∧ d.b.val ≤ 100 ⦄
theorems.proof:
theorem duty_at_most_max (p : Pulley) (c : Option PulleyCommand) (h : p.duty.val ≤ 100) :
    pulley_step p c ⦃ r => r.1.duty.val ≤ 100 ∧ ∀ d, r.2 = some d → d.a.val ≤ 100 ∧ d.b.val ≤ 100 ⦄ := by
  have hm := max_val
  rcases p with ⟨st, de, du⟩
  simp only at h

      (try split_ifs) <;> step* <;> (try simp_all) <;> (try scalar_tac) <;> (try omega)

door_step.lean:
def door_step
  (d : Door) (p : Pending) (now : Std.U64) (driver : Bool) :
  Result (Door × DoorOut)
  := do
  let b ← same d.last d.state
  match d.state with
  | DoorState.Idle =>
    let (o, last) ←
      if ¬ b
      then
        ok ({ NOTHING with pulley := (some PulleyCommand.Stop) },
          DoorState.Idle)
      else ok (NOTHING, d.last)
    match p.cmd with
    | none => ok ({ d with last }, o)
    | some c =>
      let «open» ← is_open c
      if driver
      then
        if «open»
        then
          ok ({ d with state := DoorState.Opening, last },
            { o with take_cmd := true })
        else
          ok ({ d with state := DoorState.Closing, last },
            { o with take_cmd := true })
      else ok ({ d with last }, { o with take_cmd := true })
  | DoorState.Opening =>
    let (p1, o, last, timeout, stale) ←
      if ¬ b
      then
        do
        let timeout1 ← lift (core.num.U64.saturating_add now DOOR_TIMEOUT_MS)
        let (b1, b2, b3) ←
          if p.overcurrent
          then ok (true, true, true)
          else ok (false, NOTHING.take_overcurrent, false)
        ok ({ p with overcurrent := b1 },
          {
            NOTHING
              with
              pulley := (some PulleyCommand.RampUpCCW), take_overcurrent := b2
          }, DoorState.Opening, timeout1, b3)
      else ok (p, NOTHING, d.last, d.timeout, false)
    match p1.open_limit with
    | none =>
      match p1.cmd with
      | none =>
        if p1.overcurrent
        then
          if stale
          then
            if now >= timeout
            then ok ({ state := DoorState.Idle, last, timeout }, o)
            else ok ({ state := DoorState.Opening, last, timeout }, o)
          else
            ok ({ state := DoorState.Idle, last, timeout },
              { o with take_overcurrent := true })
        else
          if now >= timeout
          then ok ({ state := DoorState.Idle, last, timeout }, o)
          else ok ({ state := DoorState.Opening, last, timeout }, o)
      | some c =>
        let «open» ← is_open c
        if «open»
        then
          ok ({ state := DoorState.Opening, last, timeout },
            { o with take_cmd := true })
        else
          ok ({ state := DoorState.Closing, last, timeout },
            { o with take_cmd := true })
    | some hit =>
      if hit
      then
        ok ({ state := DoorState.Opened, last, timeout },
          { o with take_open_limit := true })
      else
        ok ({ state := DoorState.Opening, last, timeout },
          { o with take_open_limit := true })
  | DoorState.Opened =>
    let (o, last) ←
      if ¬ b
      then
        ok ({ NOTHING with pulley := (some PulleyCommand.Stop) },
          DoorState.Opened)
      else ok (NOTHING, d.last)
    match p.cmd with
    | none => ok ({ d with last }, o)
    | some c =>
      let «open» ← is_open c
      if driver
      then
        if «open»
        then ok ({ d with last }, { o with take_cmd := true })
        else
          ok ({ d with state := DoorState.Closing, last },
            { o with take_cmd := true })
      else ok ({ d with last }, { o with take_cmd := true })
  | DoorState.Closing =>
    let (p1, o, last, timeout, stale) ←
      if ¬ b
      then
        do
        let timeout1 ← lift (core.num.U64.saturating_add now DOOR_TIMEOUT_MS)
        let (b1, b2, b3) ←
          if p.overcurrent
          then ok (true, true, true)
          else ok (false, NOTHING.take_overcurrent, false)
        ok ({ p with overcurrent := b1 },
          {
            NOTHING
              with
              pulley := (some PulleyCommand.RampUpCW), take_overcurrent := b2
          }, DoorState.Closing, timeout1, b3)
      else ok (p, NOTHING, d.last, d.timeout, false)
    match p1.close_limit with
    | none =>
      match p1.cmd with
      | none =>
        if p1.overcurrent
        then
          if stale
          then
            if now >= timeout
            then ok ({ state := DoorState.Idle, last, timeout }, o)
            else ok ({ state := DoorState.Closing, last, timeout }, o)
          else
            ok ({ state := DoorState.Opening, last, timeout },
              { o with take_overcurrent := true })
        else
          if now >= timeout
          then ok ({ state := DoorState.Idle, last, timeout }, o)
          else ok ({ state := DoorState.Closing, last, timeout }, o)
      | some c =>
        let «open» ← is_open c
        if «open»
        then
          ok ({ state := DoorState.Opening, last, timeout },
            { o with take_cmd := true })
        else
          ok ({ state := DoorState.Closing, last, timeout },
            { o with take_cmd := true })
    | some hit =>
      if hit
      then
        ok ({ state := DoorState.Closed, last, timeout },
          { o with take_close_limit := true })
      else
        ok ({ state := DoorState.Closing, last, timeout },
          { o with take_close_limit := true })
  | DoorState.Closed =>
    let (o, last) ←
      if ¬ b
      then
        ok ({ NOTHING with pulley := (some PulleyCommand.Stop) },
          DoorState.Closed)
      else ok (NOTHING, d.last)
    match p.cmd with
    | none => ok ({ d with last }, o)
    | some c =>
      let «open» ← is_open c
      if driver
      then
        if «open»
        then
          ok ({ d with state := DoorState.Opening, last },
            { o with take_cmd := true })
        else ok ({ d with last }, { o with take_cmd := true })
      else ok ({ d with last }, { o with take_cmd := true })
door_step.upstream_note: one 10 ms tick of door_state_machine_task, with F1/F2 fixed (stale overcurrent discarded, no motion without the driver)

same.lean:
def same (a : DoorState) (b : DoorState) : Result Bool := do
  match a with
  | DoorState.Idle =>
    match b with
    | DoorState.Idle => ok true
    | DoorState.Opening => ok false
    | DoorState.Opened => ok false
    | DoorState.Closing => ok false
    | DoorState.Closed => ok false
  | DoorState.Opening =>
    match b with
    | DoorState.Idle => ok false
    | DoorState.Opening => ok true
    | DoorState.Opened => ok false
    | DoorState.Closing => ok false
    | DoorState.Closed => ok false
  | DoorState.Opened =>
    match b with
    | DoorState.Idle => ok false
    | DoorState.Opening => ok false
    | DoorState.Opened => ok true
    | DoorState.Closing => ok false
    | DoorState.Closed => ok false
  | DoorState.Closing =>
    match b with
    | DoorState.Idle => ok false
    | DoorState.Opening => ok false
    | DoorState.Opened => ok false
    | DoorState.Closing => ok true
    | DoorState.Closed => ok false
  | DoorState.Closed =>
    match b with
    | DoorState.Idle => ok false
    | DoorState.Opening => ok false
    | DoorState.Opened => ok false
    | DoorState.Closing => ok false
    | DoorState.Closed => ok true
same.upstream_note: port-only helper: DoorState equality (upstream compares state and last_state with ==)

pulley_step.lean:
def pulley_step
  (p : Pulley) (cmd : Option PulleyCommand) :
  Result (Pulley × (Option Duty))
  := do
  match p.state with
  | PulleyState.Hold =>
    match cmd with
    | none =>
      match p.dest with
      | PulleyState.Hold => ok (p, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
      | PulleyState.RampingUpCCW =>
        ok
          ({
             state := PulleyState.RampingUpCCW,
             dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCCW,
             duty := 0#u8
           }, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
      | PulleyState.DrivingCCW => ok (p, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
      | PulleyState.RampingDownCCW => ok (p, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
      | PulleyState.RampingUpCW =>
        ok
          ({
             state := PulleyState.RampingUpCW,
             dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCW,
             duty := 0#u8
           }, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
      | PulleyState.DrivingCW => ok (p, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
      | PulleyState.RampingDownCW => ok (p, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
    | some pc =>
      match pc with
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCCW =>
        ok
          ({
             state := PulleyState.RampingUpCCW,
             dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCCW,
             duty := 0#u8
           }, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCW =>
        ok
          ({
             state := PulleyState.RampingUpCW,
             dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCW,
             duty := 0#u8
           }, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
      | PulleyCommand.Stop =>
        ok ({ p with dest := PulleyState.Hold }, some { a := 0#u8, b := 0#u8 })
  | PulleyState.RampingUpCCW =>
    match cmd with
    | none =>
      if p.duty < PULLEY_DUTY_MAX
      then
        let duty ← p.duty + 1#u8
        ok ({ p with duty }, some { a := duty, b := 0#u8 })
      else
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.DrivingCCW, dest := PulleyState.DrivingCCW
           }, none)
    | some pc =>
      match pc with
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCCW => ok (p, none)
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCW =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingDownCCW,
               dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCW
           }, none)
      | PulleyCommand.Stop =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingDownCCW, dest := PulleyState.Hold
           }, none)
  | PulleyState.DrivingCCW =>
    match cmd with
    | none => ok (p, some { a := PULLEY_DUTY_MAX, b := 0#u8 })
    | some pc =>
      match pc with
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCCW => ok (p, none)
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCW =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingDownCCW,
               dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCW
           }, none)
      | PulleyCommand.Stop =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingDownCCW, dest := PulleyState.Hold
           }, none)
  | PulleyState.RampingDownCCW =>
    match cmd with
    | none =>
      if p.duty > 0#u8
      then
        let duty ← p.duty - 1#u8
        ok ({ p with duty }, some { a := duty, b := 0#u8 })
      else ok ({ p with state := PulleyState.Hold }, none)
    | some pc =>
      match pc with
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCCW =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingUpCCW,
               dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCCW
           }, none)
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCW =>
        ok ({ p with dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCW }, none)
      | PulleyCommand.Stop => ok ({ p with dest := PulleyState.Hold }, none)
  | PulleyState.RampingUpCW =>
    match cmd with
    | none =>
      if p.duty < PULLEY_DUTY_MAX
      then
        let duty ← p.duty + 1#u8
        ok ({ p with duty }, some { a := 0#u8, b := duty })
      else
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.DrivingCW, dest := PulleyState.DrivingCW
           }, none)
    | some pc =>
      match pc with
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCCW =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingDownCW,
               dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCCW
           }, none)
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCW => ok (p, none)
      | PulleyCommand.Stop =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingDownCW, dest := PulleyState.Hold
           }, none)
  | PulleyState.DrivingCW =>
    match cmd with
    | none => ok (p, some { a := 0#u8, b := PULLEY_DUTY_MAX })
    | some pc =>
      match pc with
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCCW =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingDownCW,
               dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCCW
           }, none)
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCW => ok (p, none)
      | PulleyCommand.Stop =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingDownCW, dest := PulleyState.Hold
           }, none)
  | PulleyState.RampingDownCW =>
    match cmd with
    | none =>
      if p.duty > 0#u8
      then
        let duty ← p.duty - 1#u8
        ok ({ p with duty }, some { a := 0#u8, b := duty })
      else ok ({ p with state := PulleyState.Hold }, none)
    | some pc =>
      match pc with
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCCW =>
        ok ({ p with dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCCW }, none)
      | PulleyCommand.RampUpCW =>
        ok
          ({
             p
               with
               state := PulleyState.RampingUpCW,
               dest := PulleyState.RampingUpCW
           }, none)
      | PulleyCommand.Stop => ok ({ p with dest := PulleyState.Hold }, none)
pulley_step.upstream_note: one 10 ms ramp step of pulley_driver_task, with F3 fixed (a command while ramping down kept)
